title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Earlier when I was having a cigarette and looking at this view - they smoke mad cigs in Europe
I came up with a lil tweet thread
I’m mostly wondering if there’s a better part for “I have an idea”
Likely for Game 5 or 6 of the World Series....
“They don’t even let you listen to the World Series on the radio in Tigers rehab, this is crap”

“Only got a minute, but it’s going great: I can recite the Tigers’ Top 100 prospects in reverse-alphabetical order, I’m up to 47 push-ups and 114 sit-ups a day, and they’re calling Roger and I the “dream team” of crossword puzzling.”
Oh, last week Ilitch Holdings brought in a PR research firm to meet with their companies’ communications departments and share ideas on how to get Detroiters and the media off their backs.
****I have an idea: Put your money where yo—gotta go, the security guards are back
Wait, is the Ilitch Holdings thing part of the tweet thread
I guess I just think I should come up with something better than “put your money where your mouth is”
I dunno ... I don’t know if that’s the issue that hits at the core of it
Anyways I’m going to bed. Hope you enjoyed that!
